title: Ilizwi Eliyinyaniso Lamaxesha Amandulo
intro: Kukho umphefumlo kwiQuran obaliselwa kwiindinyana ezimbalwa, kodwa iimpawu zawo ezintle zikhanya ngokucacileyo. Edunyiswa nguSomandla ngenxa yobuntu obukhethekileyo, lo mkhonzi wamandulo woNonceba unendawo yakhe kumaphepha esityhilelo. Umsebenzi wakho kukubona lo mntu umangalisayo. Ungaqikelela ukuba bangoobani?
clues: Ndingumprofeti ka-Allah owayephila phakathi kwezizukulwana zokuqala zoluntu.
U-Allah undikhankanye kwiNcwadi Yakhe kunye nabanye abaprofeti, bonke benconywa ngenxa yesidima esifanayo.
U-Allah wandiphakamisa wandibeka kwindawo ephakamileyo abantu abambalwa abaye bayifikelela.
Igama lam likhankanyiwe kwiSurah Al-Anbiya, kunye nabanye abaprofeti ababini abanconywa ngomonde wabo.
